changelog:
Pitch Skill v2.3.0 — Major Overhaul for Competitive Agency Pitch Scenarios

- Fully redesigned for agency RFP/pitch competitions: six-agent, win-focused system replacing generic pitch/sales support.
- Introduces strict "Three Iron Laws" and new verifiability protocols—ensuring all logic and strategy are evidence-based, adversarial, and outcome-oriented.
- Enforces agent handoff, candidate strategy declaration, win-rate calculation, and explicit blocker/retro process at each step.
- All key agent flows and scenario triggers now documented; use cases and exclusions clarified for competitive and non-competitive contexts.
- Legacy scripts, foundation/generic references, and non-competitive workflows removed.
- File loading and Agent workflow made explicit, including stepwise checkpoints, downgrade/retry logic, and user intervention points.
- Multi-language routing and detailed reflection and learning (retro) modules added for continuous calibration.
